files.patch:
@@ -30,6 +30,9 @@ dynamo-protocols = "5.1.0"
 dynamo-renderer = "5.0.0"
 hf-hub = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["rustls-tls", "tokio"] }
 minijinja = { version = "2.24.0", features = ["unstable_machinery"] }
+# Pinned EXACTLY: this crate's accepted grammar defines the
+# "anything Rust admits, Python can compile" invariant in `sglang-server::message::sampling`.
+# A minor bump can widen it and silently reopen a scheduler-killing hole.
 regex-syntax = "=0.8.11"
 
 # Keep this paired with the server until Dynamo exposes a smaller tokenizer API.

@@ -54,16 +54,13 @@ rustix = { version = "1", features = ["fs", "mm", "shm"] }
 # Same major as the workspace pyo3: the zero-copy drain (`recv_requests`) moves
 # Rust vectors into numpy arrays.
 numpy = "0.29.0"
-# Pinned EXACTLY: this crate's accepted grammar defines the
-# "anything Rust admits, Python can compile" invariant in `message::sampling`.
-# A minor bump can widen it and silently reopen a scheduler-killing hole.
-regex-syntax = "=0.8.11"
 rmp-serde = "1"
 rmpv = { version = "1", features = ["with-serde"] }
 # The pure-Rust core of the MM pipeline. `default-features = false` drops the
 # pyo3 bindings so it links as a plain rlib; renamed so `use sglang_mm::…` reads
 # naturally while the crate keeps its own artifact name in the shared target/.
 sglang_mm = { package = "sglang-mm", path = "../sglang-mm", default-features = false }
+sglang-renderer = { path = "../sglang-renderer", default-features = false }
 
 [dev-dependencies]
 # `Router::oneshot` for handler-level router tests.
